hypothesis: conditional odds ratio of audited insulin decrease in survival-favoring knockouts exceeds one

expression.source: Rottner Table S5 CALCOCO2 silencing and control RNA experiment

join: exact source symbols, trim surrounding whitespace only, no case folding or alias repair

strata.assignment: right-closed intervals including lowest; equivalent to pandas.qcut with duplicates=drop

inference.directional_test: inclusive upper-tail at odds ratio one

sensitivity.name: threshold_free
sensitivity.diagnostic: stratum-specific per-gene median insulin LFC distributions in each replicate; descriptive, not confirmatory

implementation_clarifications_before_res.valid_directional_guide: nonmissing exact gene and guide key, r0/r1 suffix, finite LFC/FDR and control/treatment counts; unique key within replicate; no count-sum threshold for direction audit or medians
implementation_clarifications_before_res.three_guide_sensitivity: published directional hits failing the stricter three-guide audit remain unresolved and are excluded symmetrically, using the same failed-audit handling as primary
implementation_clarifications_before_res.positive_vs_negative_strata: use primary-U expression boundaries and coverage labels, then restrict to positive/negative hits
implementation_clarifications_before_res.fisher_estimate: report sample odds ratio and independent conditional maximum-likelihood estimate with exact conditional interval
implementation_clarifications_before_res.external_functional_evidence: not systematically assessed for individual candidates; record unknown, never infer from hit absence
implementation_clarifications_before_res.sensitivity_quintiles: Rebuild within each sensitivity universe; positive-vs-negative alone retains primary-U bins. FDR-only universe remains unchanged.
implementation_clarifications_before_res.stronger_fixed_universe_diagnostic: In addition to symmetric exclusions, secondary diagnostic retains primary U and sets L=1 only for published decreases satisfying >=3 directional guides per replicate; L=0 is absence of this stricter evidence, not preserved content.
